headline: Growth in health services lifts results as outlook is raised
summary_short: Cigna's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 7.0% y/y to $71.7 billion and diluted EPS grew 10.2% to $6.29, driven by growth in Cigna Healthcare, with the company raising its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to at least $30.45.
summary_long: Total revenues grew 7% y/y to $71.7 billion, led by growth at both Evernorth Health Services and Cigna Healthcare. Adjusted income from operations rose 6% y/y to $7.78 per share on higher Cigna Healthcare contributions; within Evernorth, Specialty and Care Services pre-tax income grew 22% on specialty volume and generic/biosimilar adoption, while Pharmacy Benefit Services pre-tax income fell 27% on client-contract renewals. Cigna Healthcare's medical care ratio rose to 84.5% from 83.2%, mainly reflecting favorable prior-year risk-adjustment benefits recognized a year earlier. Shareholders' equity grew 6.0% y/y to $42.6 billion. Cigna raised its full-year 2026 adjusted income from operations outlook to at least $30.45 per share (+$0.10) and lifted Cigna Healthcare's full-year pre-tax outlook by $25 million.
